documentation:
## Twist Rainbow Shell

### Description

This graph demonstrates the buckling and plastic deformation of the MPM shell model through constraints.

### Inputs, Controls & Outputs

The input geometry and constraints are constructed in the `construct_object` compound, the number, size and spacing of the geometry can be controlled.  The attributes to "wedge" or vary between the cylinders is controlled by the `wedging_attributes` compound.

### Useful information

- The shell deformation model assumes the geometry will be subdivided when rendering. This is not currently done in the graph.
